recommendation: 8 structured-response prompts for this college-level introductory lesson
rationale: Eight provides focused coverage across hardware, programming process, syntax/semantics, language classification, translation models, and error diagnosis, with two applied code tasks. This is a pilot set rather than a full examination blueprint.

coverage.INTRO-E01: map roles in a hardware scenario
coverage.INTRO-E02: apply the two-phase model and connect skills
coverage.INTRO-E03: compare syntax and semantics across examples
coverage.INTRO-E06: classify and distinguish concrete error causes
coverage.INTRO-E07: trace and correct a logical loop error
coverage.INTRO-E08: trace an integrated program and explain its operators
